_comment: Real, dedicated Nostr identities generated once for this test suite's own use (not shared with anything else, no funds/reputation attached) - not synthetic/placeholder data. 'provider' publishes a kind:3 (NIP-02 contact list) follow list naming every 'members' entry at relay-seed time (see seedrelay/main.go, run via `just dev seed-relay` / `just dev reset`), so circle-hub "following"-policy tests that want a stable, already-authorized identity can use these directly instead of generating a fresh keypair and live-publishing a follow list over the network on every run. A pubkey NOT listed under 'members' (e.g. a freshly generated one) is a ready-made 'not followed' identity for rejection-path tests - no separate 'nonmember' fixture needed.
